title: VendPoint Planogram Service Levels by Model
content:
Merchandising service levels of the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program, by machine model.

- **Included selection changes**: selection changes per calendar quarter without a fee.
- **Planogram change fee**: fee per selection change beyond the included changes, USD.
- **Planogram review interval**: months between Corbett planogram reviews.
- **Slow-mover removal**: days without a vend after which a selection is removed at the planogram review.
- **Special item selections**: selections that may hold non-catalog special items.

| | VendPoint Locker 12 | VendPoint Locker 24 | VendPoint Coil 40 | VendPoint Coil 60 | VendPoint Carousel 90 | VendPoint Smart Crib 300 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Included selection changes per calendar quarter | 4 | 8 | 12 | 20 | 30 | 100 |
| Planogram change fee, USD | 15.00 | 15.00 | 12.00 | 10.00 | 8.00 | 0.00 |
| Planogram review interval, months | 6 | 6 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 1 |
| Slow-mover removal, days without a vend | 120 | 120 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 60 |
| Special item selections, at most | 0 | 2 | 4 | 6 | 10 | 40 |

### Points of reading

- The VendPoint Locker 12 allows no non-catalog special item (0 selections).
- The VendPoint Smart Crib 300 change fee is 0.00 USD.
- Included changes are counted per calendar quarter, not per rolling three months.
